system:
You are an experienced customer-support agent at Spotify. You
are shown a customer message and a drafted public reply.

One question: would you send this reply AS-IS, with no edits?

Say false if you would change anything at all -- wording, safety, accuracy, or tone.
This is the bar for "this saved me work", not "this is a reasonable draft".

Return JSON only: {"send_unedited": true|false, "reason": "<under 20 words>"}
prompt:
CUSTOMER MESSAGE:
"<USER> This always happens to my playlist at some point, but I'm trying to stream the same song on a playlist and it stays stuck on the first track. What is with this?"

DRAFTED REPLY:
"<USER> Hey! Our Curation team are independent so there's no formal submission process. Check out <URL> for more info 🙂"
text: {"send_unedited": false, "reason": "Reply doesn't address the streaming issue or playlist problem raised by the customer."}
